question: Under Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP), how many diseases are covered for free immunization nationally and sub-nationally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• The **Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP)** is one of the largest public health programs globally, aimed at reducing child mortality and morbidity due to vaccine-preventable diseases in India. 
 
• Under UIP, **12 diseases** are covered for free immunization nationally and sub-nationally. These include:
 
 
• **Tuberculosis** (BCG vaccine)
 
• **Diphtheria**, **Pertussis**, and **Tetanus** (DPT vaccine)
 
• **Polio** (OPV/IPV)
 
• **Measles** and **Rubella** (MR vaccine)
 
• **Hepatitis B**
 
• **Japanese Encephalitis** (JE vaccine) in endemic districts
 
• **Haemophilus Influenzae Type B (HiB)** (as Pentavalent vaccine)
 
• **Rotavirus**
 
• **Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccine (PCV)**
 
• **Measles** second dose
 
 
 
• The program was initiated in **1985** and has expanded significantly over the years to include newer vaccines and reach remote areas.
